Settlement: Flint Orchard Settlement
Deed date: 21 October 2022
Lodged parent deed reference: PD-6894-R
Settlor: Cora Teague
Original trustees: Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell

Clause 8 — Addition of Objects
All serving trustees, acting together, may by deed add any named living individual other than the settlor or a serving trustee. No other person’s consent is required.

An addition takes effect when the trustees jointly deliver the designation as a deed. On delivery through the common custody service, the trustees may identify the settlement by giving its lodged parent deed reference against the unique reference written on the designation. The settlement name need not be written on the designation. The register records the delivery, not the designation.

Existing Objects remain Objects unless separately removed by deed.

Instrument reference: SD-Q7M2

Rhea Marden, a living individual, is designated as an additional Object eligible for discretionary appointments of income and capital under the parent deed for which the trustees jointly deliver this instrument as a deed.

Signed as a deed by Nell Carvane: [signed]  
In the presence of Della Pennick: [signed]

Signed as a deed by Tobin Rell: [signed]  
In the presence of Della Pennick: [signed]

Instrument reference: SD-Q7M2  
Parent deed reference: PD-6894-R

At 11:30 GMT on 26 March 2026, Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell attended together and released one signed paper original for immediate delivery as a deed, not in escrow. At handover, both confirmed the parent deed reference against the instrument reference on the face of the paper.

source_audit.finding: Read as both a procedural note and an appointments-book report. It independently supports all four current trustee edges and supplies continuity evidence for the deed-based routes. Booking, preparation instructions and the reproduced brief do not establish object status or authorise payments. Late papers are outside the closed set.

Certified selected terms of PD-6834-R independently support the Alder Quay settlor and both original-object edges. Original appointments support, but do not independently prove, current office. The joint discretion, addition and retention clauses control the Alder Quay analysis; its reference does not match SD-Q7M2's delivery record.

Certified selected terms of PD-6894-R independently support the Flint Orchard settlor and both named-object edges. Original appointments support the continuity route for both trustees. The named parent reference and clause 8 are essential to the Rhea Marden chain. Clause 5 is a power, not a recorded decision.

A checked transcript of the one signed designation, not a second instrument. Supplies Rhea Marden, SD-Q7M2, witnessed execution, conditional effect on joint delivery and the express limits of the addition. No named parent, independent delivery attestation, removal or payment authority.

A certified copy of one register entry made from the custody officer's first-hand handover, not a duplicate report of the designation text. Supplies the exact SD-Q7M2/PD-6894-R link, both participants, one original and immediate joint delivery. Shared labels carry no trust meaning; the question-mark convention does not alter these fully reproduced fields. This is neither a standalone beneficiary statement nor a current appointments record.

First-person evidence of the estimate problem, Sella Quist's limited permission and the request to consider help in her own right. Ione Berrick disclaims the listed payment arrangements and does not claim to know what either deed allows. No independent proof of an object, trustee or family edge.

Separate ordinary finance evidence: £12.60 reimbursed from the office account and £8.40 unresolved, with no recharge and no distribution instruction. The remit is restricted to EX-K4. It supports no graph edge and is not a substitute for a recorded decision in either settlement.
